lines: Scout a Pillager Outpost and return with a crossbow as proof of the threat.
That chapter is closed. We already settled Fletcher's Countermark.
The matter ended well enough. You already came back from the Pillager Outpost with what we needed.
There is no second payment here. Fletcher's Countermark is closed. I am not sending you through pillagers watching the road twice.
I remember your first return. Your route to the Pillager Outpost is already in the defense plan.
What was owed has been paid. I remember the day you returned with the crossbow.
You finished what I asked. You earned the reward for Fletcher's Countermark, and it was paid.
I remember your first return. We have proof with weight because you finished the journey to the Pillager Outpost.
I will not reopen a finished account. Nothing remains to be recovered from the outpost.
We settled this one already. What you brought from the Pillager Outpost is still helping the village.
Leave the old tally alone. You proved the outpost route once. That is enough.
Your earlier work still stands. The defense plan carries your name beside the completed mark.
That chapter is closed. Leave Fletcher's Countermark in the past where it belongs.
You finished what I asked. You settled every part of Fletcher's Countermark on your first return.
Your earlier work still stands. The Pillager Outpost was reached and the crossbow evidence delivered.
You finished what I asked. I will find you a road beyond the Pillager Outpost before sending you back there.
I remember your first return. Nobody forgot what the journey to the Pillager Outpost cost you.
There is no second payment here. Fletcher's Countermark at the Pillager Outpost needs no second visit from you.
You finished what I asked. You gave us the crossbow, not another rumor.
I remember your first return. Fletcher's Countermark ended properly, and it stays ended.
Your earlier work still stands. We can look ahead now. Fletcher's Countermark is done.
I am keeping this off the board. The conditions for Fletcher's Countermark are not right at the moment.
The time is wrong. The mark for the Pillager Outpost is not open today.
The board can wait. I have no reason to risk you against pillagers watching the road just now.
The board can wait. The village is not ready to use a crossbow and 24 arrows.
The board can wait. Wait until the defense plan calls for the journey to the Pillager Outpost.
I am keeping this off the board. A trip to the Pillager Outpost without a need is only danger.

We have no need of it yet. I am holding Fletcher's Countermark off the board for now.
The board can wait. Nothing at the Pillager Outpost needs our answer today.
The village can wait on this one. Keep your gear ready for the Pillager Outpost, but do not leave yet.
Nothing calls for this work today. Fletcher's Countermark is real. The moment for it is not.
The time is wrong. I will not send you toward pillagers watching the road to satisfy an old note.
We have no need of it yet. The Pillager Outpost can wait until we have a use for the return.
The village can wait on this one. Ask again after the village reviews the defense plan.
I will post it when it matters. There is no active claim on the crossbow today.
Not today. The road toward the Pillager Outpost is quiet, and I mean to leave it that way.
Leave that work alone for now. Starting Fletcher's Countermark now would spend courage for no useful result.
I am keeping this off the board. Fletcher's Countermark has not been posted to any traveler.
I will post it when it matters. Give Fletcher's Countermark time to become necessary.
There is no reason to begin yet. For the moment, stay on this side of the journey to the Pillager Outpost.
We need a trustworthy route first. I cannot pin the outpost from here. The mark may be old, or worse, moving.
Something is wrong with the chart. I cannot put a trustworthy mark on the Pillager Outpost.
Until I know the way, you stay here. Every route I checked breaks down before the outpost.
My map has failed us. The Pillager Outpost maps disagree, and pillagers watching the road leave no room for guessing.
I will not guess at a route. I found rumors of the Pillager Outpost, but no road I would hand you.
We need a trustworthy route first. The Pillager Outpost has slipped beyond my Pillager Outpost charts.
I will not guess at a route. Without a firm bearing, Fletcher's Countermark would be wandering.
The trail has gone cold. My best map is blank where the outpost should be.
No mark is better than a false one. I traced three routes toward the Pillager Outpost and trusted none.
A doubtful map is too much risk. The old Pillager Outpost directions end before danger begins.
We need a trustworthy route first. I will not pretend a guess can mark the Pillager Outpost.
Until I know the way, you stay here. No scout has confirmed the mark for the Pillager Outpost.
I found no safe bearing to give you. The trail to the Pillager Outpost went cold before I could mark it.
Until I know the way, you stay here. I need Pillager Outpost coordinates, not campfire stories.
I cannot send you out blind. The Pillager Outpost may be there, but I cannot prove where.
The old directions no longer agree. None of the Pillager Outpost bearings lead to the same ground.
A doubtful map is too much risk. Let me find an honest outpost route before you prepare to leave.
I will not guess at a route. The defense plan offers warnings today, not directions.
The trail has gone cold. The Pillager Outpost map gives me doubt when I need certainty.
Until I know the way, you stay here. Come back after the road to the Pillager Outpost gives us an answer.
The evidence still matters. Bring a crossbow from the threat. I want weight, not rumor.
What you carried home decides this. The crossbow is still missing from your return.
You returned without the one thing I asked for. I cannot close the defense plan without the agreed crossbow evidence.
A story cannot close the ledger. You faced the Pillager Outpost, but the village still needs the crossbow.
I need something I can hold. Bring back a crossbow and 24 arrows before we settle Fletcher's Countermark.
The evidence still matters. Your story may be true. I still need the crossbow.
The evidence still matters. The journey to the Pillager Outpost ends here when the crossbow changes hands.
You returned without the one thing I asked for. Do not reach the Pillager Outpost and forget the crossbow that verifies it.
I believe you went, but that is not enough. I know you traveled. I need a result from the Pillager Outpost.
You returned without the one thing I asked for. The Fletcher's Countermark reward waits on the crossbow evidence, not the telling.
You returned without the one thing I asked for. Show me the crossbow, and Fletcher's Countermark can close.
The last requirement is still missing. The empty place in the defense plan waits for what you recovered.
Bring back something the village can verify. Words cannot stand in for proof with weight.
I believe you went, but that is not enough. Check your packs before you make the journey to the Pillager Outpost twice.
Show me what came back with you. Fletcher's Countermark named its proof from the beginning.
You returned without the one thing I asked for. Bring the crossbow evidence here rather than leaving it in storage.
Bring back something the village can verify. The village asked for a crossbow and 24 arrows, and that remains unfinished.
You returned without the one thing I asked for. I can record the outpost route after I see what came from it.
Show me what came back with you. One crossbow handoff separates Fletcher's Countermark from completion.
Bring back something the village can verify. Return when the crossbow is in your hands.
This task was never only about the cargo. A crossbow can come from many hands. I need you to scout the outpost itself.
Going near it does not count. You have not confirmed the Pillager Outpost itself.
The map still shows unfinished travel. The cargo means little if the Pillager Outpost was never reached.
You have not gone far enough yet. Fletcher's Countermark includes the road as well as the return.
You have not gone far enough yet. Set foot in the outpost before you bring me evidence.
I need the site confirmed. I asked for proof from the Pillager Outpost, not somewhere else.
Reaching the mark is part of the promise. The Pillager Outpost remains untouched in the defense plan.
This task was never only about the cargo. Finish the outward journey before claiming the Fletcher's Countermark reward.
The road must end where I sent you. A borrowed crossbow cannot replace reaching the Pillager Outpost.
I need the site confirmed. The Pillager Outpost map still says you stopped short.
Finish the outward journey first. Go to the marked place and see Fletcher's Countermark through there.
The place itself must be reached. The outpost route must end at the Pillager Outpost, not near it.
I need the site confirmed. I need your eyes on the Pillager Outpost before I trust the report.
Finish the outward journey first. Do not skip the part that puts pillagers watching the road in front of you.
The place itself must be reached. The village asked you to confirm the outpost existed.
Finish the outward journey first. Your return is early. the Pillager Outpost still waits.
Finish the outward journey first. Reach the Pillager Outpost, then recover a crossbow and 24 arrows.
The road must end where I sent you. The journey to the Pillager Outpost is not complete while the final mark is unvisited.
The place itself must be reached. The defense plan needs a confirmed place, not only an item.
Reaching the mark is part of the promise. Turn back toward the Pillager Outpost and finish what you began.
Do not let one finished step distract you. Outpost near {target_x}, {target_z}. Crossbow for proof, 24 arrows so we answer properly.
Stay with the work you accepted. The Pillager Outpost is still near {target_x}, {target_z}.

You are not finished yet. Check the map again. Pillager Outpost is still near {target_x}, {target_z}.
Do not let one finished step distract you. Fletcher's Countermark still calls for a crossbow and 24 arrows.

Before you leave, hear this again. Your return should give us proof with weight.

Remember what the village is waiting for. The defense plan stays open until you come home.
Bring this to a proper finish. Do not rush blind toward the Pillager Outpost. Follow the mark and return whole.

Bring this to a proper finish. Pillager Outpost still waits near {target_x}, {target_z}.

The next step still matters. Find the Pillager Outpost, do Fletcher's Countermark there, and return to me.

Take this seriously. I marked the Pillager Outpost near {target_x}, {target_z}.

Let us be clear about the job. The job is to measure the threat before it reaches us.
Listen closely. Come home with a crossbow and 24 arrows so the village has more than rumors.
I need you to see this through. The road leads through pillagers watching the road, so prepare before leaving.
Take this seriously. I need someone willing to reach the Pillager Outpost and return with proof.
Take the task only if you are ready. The Pillager Outpost sits near {target_x}, {target_z}, according to my map.
Take the task only if you are ready. Follow the {direction} bearing and keep the defense plan dry.
Here is the work. Fletcher's Countermark begins at the Pillager Outpost and ends when the crossbow reaches me.
Before you agree, hear all of it. The Pillager Outpost mark is about {distance} blocks away. Do not mistake speed for care.
Take this seriously. Bring a crossbow and 24 arrows, and I can turn this risk into something useful.
I am trusting you with something important. The village needs proof with weight, not boasting at the fire.
Take this seriously. I trust you with the outpost route because it is not kind.
Listen closely. Make for {target_x}, {target_z} and confirm the Pillager Outpost yourself.
This needs a careful hand. Prepare for pillagers watching the road before crossing the last safe ground.
I need you to see this through. The outward journey proves the Pillager Outpost map. The return proves you.
Take this seriously. Do not come back empty from the outpost.
I need you to see this through. Take Fletcher's Countermark only if you mean to finish the travel and recovery.
I need you to see this through. When you have a crossbow and 24 arrows, bring it straight here.
That is the result I needed. That is enough proof. The village will know where to point its <dark_gray><wavy>fear</wavy></dark_gray>, and its arrows.
You saw it through. You reached the Pillager Outpost and brought the crossbow home.
Good, you made it back. The defense plan finally has a true ending.
You delivered exactly what was needed. This is proof with weight, solid enough to hold.
You brought the work to a proper end. The village can measure the threat before it reaches us because you took the risk.
This return was worth waiting for. I asked for a crossbow and 24 arrows, and you returned with every part.
You saw it through. You went through pillagers watching the road and kept your head.
I am glad to see you home. The outpost route is confirmed now, not merely drawn.
The village can use this. I can pay Fletcher's Countermark without a doubt.
You brought the work to a proper end. The crossbow tells the story better than any boast.
That is the result I needed. You made the dangerous road to the Pillager Outpost useful to everyone here.
The village can use this. The Pillager Outpost is no longer just a warning on a map.

The village can use this. Fletcher's Countermark is clean, even if the journey to the Pillager Outpost was not.
You brought the work to a proper end. That is the crossbow evidence I hoped to see.
Now I can close the ledger. You returned from the Pillager Outpost with more than survival. You brought an answer.
I am glad to see you home. Fletcher's Countermark closes with the village better prepared.
The village can use this. The next traveler to the Pillager Outpost will have your route.
The village can use this. Take the Fletcher's Countermark reward. You earned it beyond the safe roads.
You brought the work to a proper end. I am glad to see both the crossbow and person carrying it.
I need proof of your judgment first. You are not the scout I need for this yet.
Earn our confidence before asking again. Fletcher's Countermark demands trust I do not have in you yet.
I need proof of your judgment first. I cannot hand you a route through pillagers watching the road today.
Come back after you have earned more trust. The Pillager Outpost is no ground for an untested ally.
Some work must wait until trust catches up. Do steadier work here before asking for the Pillager Outpost map.

The answer is no for now. Fletcher's Countermark risks more than the traveler's life.
I cannot trust you with this yet. Earn our confidence, then ask about the outpost again.
The answer is no for now. I will not send a stranger after proof with weight.
This calls for someone we know better. The Pillager Outpost is dangerous enough without doubt between us.
Come back after you have earned more trust. Your name has not reached the trusted page of the defense plan.
Some work must wait until trust catches up. There are safer tasks than Fletcher's Countermark that can show me how you work.
You are not ready for this request. I need proof of judgment before offering the journey to the Pillager Outpost.
This work is not yours today. For now, the Pillager Outpost map remains folded.
The village needs a steadier hand. The village is not ready to stake measure the threat before it reaches us on you.
This work is not yours today. Ask about the Pillager Outpost after you have stood with us longer.

This calls for someone we know better. Fletcher's Countermark stays with proven hands.
Come back after you have earned more trust. I will tell you when we trust you with the road to the Pillager Outpost.
